method: Bounded Node development check, alternating old/new helper calls on identical already-created ExtrudeGeometry. Three measured pairs per layout, both implementations in the same process. This is a construction check, not a browser/GPU, power, temperature or release-decision benchmark. System load was not controlled.
outputEquivalence: Every position, normal and UV Float32 array was byte-identical for shell, dark reveal and all five orange bands in both layouts on all three pairs.
modelNote: Current complete model, default CPU-only model construction; two successive calls in a separate Node process. No matched pre-change complete-model comparison was made.
change: Index nearby aperture contour segments in a temporary build-time grid; copy original attributes directly for triangles wholly owned by one material. Polygon clipping remains only at paint boundaries. No renderer callbacks, render-time caching or geometry reductions added.
validation: node --test tests/flush-window-reveals.test.mjs: 3/3 pass. Changed helper/test lint and git diff checks clean.
